        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int budget = sc.nextInt();

        int[] tab = new int[n];
        int even = 0;
        int odd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            tab[i] = sc.nextInt();

                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
        }

            System.out.println(0);
            return;

                used += cost;
                count++;

        int odd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < tab.length - 1; i++) {
            if ((tab[i] & 1) == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            if (even == odd) {
                cuts.add(Math.abs(tab[i + 1] - tab[i]));
            }
        }
    }
